events.title: Spellfall Has a New Name!
events.summary: Spellfall: Last Mage Standing is now Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem.The name may be changing, but the game is not. Spellfall is still the same fast-paced arena brawler where up to six mages draft powerful spells and items, battle through seven rounds, and try to come out on top as the arena crumbles beneath their feet. events.title: A Year in the Arena
events.summary: One year ago I began development on what would eventually become Spellfall: Last Mage Standing. I set out with the intention of creating an arena brawler that would be fun to play solo or with friends, both casually or competitively.
